program.description: Master of Science in Data Science. Official-source pilot; applicant-category restrictions require review.

requirements.label: Accepted first degrees and equivalent competence profiles
requirements.sourceText: A completed Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Industrial Mathematics, Mathematical Economy, Computer Science, Data Science, or Physics from FAU or another equivalent German or international degree that is not significantly different with regard to the competence profile taught in the respective degree program. Please note that your competence profile cannot be evaluated in advance, but only by the admission committee after completing the application process (described below).

requirements.label: English proficiency and exemptions (wording requires reconciliation)
requirements.sourceText:
As the Master programme is in English we are asking for a certificate of upper intermediate English (level B2) are mandatory. Even if your undergraduate degree was taught in English we recommend to submit a language certificate. For everyday life and for internships and working student jobs, we recommend solid knowledge (B1) of German, but a certificate is not necessary for the application.

English proficiency at level B2 CEFR (vantage or upper intermediate) or six years of English classes at a German secondary school (Gymnasium). Applicants who have completed their university entrance qualifications or their first degree in English are not required to provide proof of proficiency in English.

program.admissionText:
academic: A completed Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Industrial Mathematics, Mathematical Economy, Computer Science, Data Science, or Physics from FAU or another equivalent German or international degree that is not significantly different with regard to the competence profile taught in the respective degree program. Please note that your competence profile cannot be evaluated in advance, but only by the admission committee after completing the application process (described below).

academic: A Grade Point Average (GPA) of 2.5 or better with respect to the German grading system. Candidates with an admissible degree (described above) and a GPA between 2.6 and 2.8 are invited for a short online interview in which their knowledge in calculus, linear algebra, algorithms and data structures is evaluated.

language: As the Master programme is in English we are asking for a certificate of upper intermediate English (level B2) are mandatory. Even if your undergraduate degree was taught in English we recommend to submit a language certificate. For everyday life and for internships and working student jobs, we recommend solid knowledge (B1) of German, but a certificate is not necessary for the application.

English proficiency at level B2 CEFR (vantage or upper intermediate) or six years of English classes at a German secondary school (Gymnasium). Applicants who have completed their university entrance qualifications or their first degree in English are not required to provide proof of proficiency in English.

language: English proficiency at level B2 CEFR (vantage or upper intermediate, not be older than 2 years) or six years of English classes at a German secondary school (Gymnasium). Applicants who have completed their university entrance qualifications or their first degree in English are not required to provide proof of proficiency in English. A list of accepted language proficiency certificates can be found here.

deadline: The following information is intended for German applicants as well as domestic applicants with foreign educational qualifications. Different regulations and deadlines may apply to international prospective students.

Winter semester: 31.05.

Summer semester: 30.11.

application: Applications have to be submitted via the campus management portal campo.fau.de.

tuition: FAU charges tuition fees per semester for students from non-EU states who enroll at FAU for the first time or change subjects from summer semester 2027.

Data Science* | Master of Science | Yes | 4,000 euros

Unless stated otherwise, the tuition fees are for full-time study. Tuition fees are halved for part-time study.

If you obtained a Bachelor’s degree from a German university, you are generally exempt from paying tuition fees for the Master’s degree program. This is subject to the condition that you complete your Bachelor’s degree program successfully before commencing the Master’s degree program.

application: As of winter semester 2026/27, FAU will be charging a processing fee of 100 euros per application for applicants from non-EU states.

This fee is due regardless of the result of the selection process and cannot be reimbursed. A maximum of three applications (maximum 300 euros) can be made per person and application phase. Applications are checked only after payment has been made. The answers to the most frequently asked questions on this topic can be found below.

German citizenship or

German university entrance qualification or

Students already enrolled at FAU in the winter semester 2026/27, or

Bachelor’s degree obtained in Germany (at least six semesters) or

Citizenship from a country in the European Economic Area (EEA, includes EU member states and Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway), from a state with the equivalent status, or from countries with whom relevant agreements are in place or

Individuals with established ties to Germany. These include individuals who have been living in Germany for at least five years before beginning a degree program and who have been in legal employment during this time or who have at least one parent who has been living in Germany during three of the last six years and who was in legal employment during this time. An exemption is only possible upon presentation of proof. Please contact bewerbungsgebuehren@fau.de.

Applicants who are offered a place on a degree program but were unable to enroll in that semester (due to visa problems or such like), and who reapply for the identical degree program in the same year are exempt from paying the application fee. This only applies to reapplications within the same academic year, provided the degree program has not been changed significantly in a manner that affects the admissions procedure. It does not apply to degree programs with admission restrictions. When reapplying, the admissions letter from one of the two preceding semesters must be uploaded to the application portal.
